text:
maria: Quick kickoff — Harvest testimonial recording runbook. Customer: SolrTech. Need: recorded interview (PM + Eng), 2 short quotes (product + impact), signed release, transcript redlines, final social headlines. Target publish: Tue Apr 21 2026. Doc: https://drive.redwood/harvest-testimonial (please request access if you need it). Can Legal confirm sign-off timeline?

 tom: I can schedule the recording Thurs 11am PT — will capture ~20m. Need a 6-question script and a list of desired soundbites.

 eli: Routing question — where do leads from the gated asset go? We should route webinar registrants to Growth queue + AE handoff. Also want a webhook for demo requests.

 katie: For social: we'll prepare two headline camps (product-first, impact-first). I can draft 3 headline variations + 3 short captions by Fri. Also want 1 CTA that links to the gated whitepaper.

 sam: sam (Legal) — please attach the release template you want Legal to review. We need to know whether quotes are embargoed and whether we need org-level sign-off.

 maria: Pasting the release template snippet and a couple sample quote picks below. Comments welcome.

 ```Release form (snippet):
I, [Full Name], on behalf of [Company], grant Redwood Inference the right to record, reproduce, and publish my testimonial and quotes, including use in marketing, social media, and promotional materials. I confirm I have authority to grant this release.
Fields: Full name; Title; Company; Email; Date; Signature (typed is OK).
Embargo clause: "Content must not be published before [publish date] without written consent."
```

 maria: Sample quote picks (short):
- "Redwood cut inference cost by 3x while improving latency for our end users." — PM
- "We shipped a LLM-powered feature three weeks faster thanks to Redwood's unified API." — Eng lead

 assets-bot: Checklist generated: [Recording scheduled: Thurs 11am PT], [Release form drafted], [Transcript redline requested], [Design hero + screenshots], [Social copies drafted], [Lead routing configured], [Publish date set]. Checklist link: https://drive.redwood/checklists/harvest-001

 tom: I'll pull raw audio + a machine transcript and drop both in the doc. I'll timestamp likely soundbites (00:45, 05:10, 12:30). :thumbsup:

 eli: For lead routing: add hidden form field source=harvest-landing, set utm_campaign=harvest-2026, post leads to /hooks/leads/harvest. Tag leads with [harvest-wp, webinar-reg]. Can marketing confirm permissions for auto-AE assign?

 katie: Yes, Growth ok with auto-assign for MQL score > 50. We'll map fields: email, company, title, utm_campaign, interest_level. Also want a follow-up sequence: 1) thanks email, 2) 3-day nurture with invite to webinar.

 sam: Legal looked at the release. Approves language with two small edits: (1) add explicit KOL consent line, (2) clarify no financial compensation implied. Please use the redline link: https://drive.redwood/legal/harvest-release-redline

 maria: Great — timeline check:
- Recording: Thu (confirmed)
- Draft quotes & social: Fri EOD
- Legal final: Wed EOD (need signed release before publish)
- Design assets: Mon Apr 20
- Final sign-off / go-no-go: Fri 9am PT

maria: Also note — keep all direct quotes under 140 characters for social; annotate timestamps in the transcript so we can pull soundbites quickly. If anyone needs to pull a different angle (benchmarks vs. narrative), flag now. Thanks! :pray:
